# Owned recursive enum and closed context fixture

Class<E>, String and E retain the method's recursive Enum<Self> bound.
An opaque provider checks original String identity, null and mismatched tokens,
callbacks, results and exact late failures. A separate client invokes the real
SDK Enum.valueOf with valid names, absent names, nulls, empty, padded, lowercase,
NUL and Unicode names. Four immutable caller routes run 96 fresh JVM cases twice.
Source and SDK-provider profiles compile every unit and preserve original entries
and metadata. Six wrong programs and six Code-preserving controls guard scope,
context erasure and behavior. Only owned fixture and standard SDK code executes.
Use JDK 25; originals use release 8 and recovery uses its reported Java release.
